LOGISTICS SERVICE AGREEMENT

Client: TechCorp India Pvt Ltd
Service Provider: FleetFusion Logistics

DELIVERY TERMS:
- Origin: Pune, Maharashtra
- Destination: Mumbai, Maharashtra
- Delivery window: 3 hours from dispatch (15 minute grace)
- Cargo: just-in-time components for an assembly line (declared value Rs 1 crore)

PENALTY CLAUSE:
- Rs 25,000 per hour of delay beyond the grace period (line stoppage pass-through)
- Maximum penalty capped at Rs 1,25,000

FORCE MAJEURE:
Weather, natural disasters, and government-mandated closures exempt from penalties.
